runtime: live operator database, harness_shared.session_turn_windows_state status=ready (windows route available), exact-tier deadline 2000 ms; host load average ~93 on 128 cores during the run (measured, not a controlled idle host)
command: LEGACY=1 tsx .papercusp/scratch/p011-measure-windows.mts  # prints AVAIL, then one TIERS line per literal (windows route, through retrieveSessionTurnLiteralTiers) and LEGACY lines (forced legacy route control); log .papercusp/scratch/p011-measure-run-b.log
summary: Re-measure of the R-1 receipt against the current source (recency walk landed, WI-10005294 / plan decision D-015). With the windows index ready, the exact tier answers every probed literal with status=ran and 150 hits inside the 2000 ms deadline: 'finder' 1175 ms, 'error' 1284 ms, 'the' 1231 ms, 'function' 1277 ms, 'papercusp' 1319 ms (exact-tier elapsedMs from the receipt). The previously disclosed residue (near-ubiquitous literals 'the' and 'papercusp' returning status=deadline with 0 hits in the 2026-10-02 receipt) is therefore closed on the live corpus. The forced-legacy control for 'finder' still hits the deadline (deadline=true, 54 partial hits at 2037 ms), so the improvement is the windows route and not a warm cache. Caveat: exact-tier elapsedMs sits at 1.2-1.3 s of the 2.0 s deadline on a heavily loaded host, so the margin is real but not large.

assertions.evidence: TIERS {"lit":"finder","ms":2080,"exactHits":150,"exactReceipt":{"status":"ran","returned":150,"elapsedMs":1175}} — status ran, 150 hits, 1175 ms exact-tier elapsed against a 2000 ms deadline (AVAIL {"exact":{"available":true,"route":"windows"},"policy":{"deadline":2000}}).

LEGACY {"lit":"finder","ms":2037,"hits":54,"deadline":true} — the unchanged substring route on the same corpus still hits the deadline for the R-1 example literal, so the improvement comes from the windows route and not a warm cache.
TIERS error: status ran, 150 hits, 1284 ms. TIERS function: status ran, 150 hits, 1277 ms. LEGACY error control: 150 hits, 98 ms, no deadline.

TIERS the: status ran, 150 hits, 1231 ms. TIERS papercusp: status ran, 150 hits, 1319 ms. In the 2026-10-02 receipt both returned status deadline with 0 hits (2013 ms / 2015 ms); the recency walk (WI-10005294, plan decision D-015) closes that residue.
